how_this_was_built: Generated by reading every .ots file in dirs_scanned and keeping only those that deserialize as an OpenTimestamps detached proof. Never from a list of files we intended to stamp, and never copied from a staged manifest.
bitcoin_attested_means: The proof bytes carry a BitcoinBlockHeaderAttestation, parsed by python-opentimestamps. This producer does not check the block header against a Bitcoin node; `ots verify` with a node does that.
pending_is_not_anchored: A calendar-pending proof is a submitted request, not evidence of a time. Only a Bitcoin attestation is that.
subject_absent_means: The proof commits to a digest, but the file it is named for is not served beside it. A reader cannot check what was stamped; it is an anchor without a subject.
supersedes: csoai.ots-manifest/0.3 (2026-09-17), which was true of one directory, /interop/ots/, and so reported 10 proofs and 0 Bitcoin-attested while the proofs served from /interop/ were not counted; and 0.2, which claimed 566 proofs of which none parsed. See the correction register.
